messages.subject: Typos in layout guide article
parts:
I've found some typos in the documentation but I don't see how to submit corrections. I could add a comment to the article but it seemed heavy-handed to add a permanent comment to the page about minor typos that could be fixed quickly.

Specifically on http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/layout-guide.html there are two extraneous apostrophes:
"The first parameter to the column() function is it’s width"
"The fluid system always occupies the full width of the web page and re-sizes it’s components dynamically"

Is there a preferred way to flag minor errors like this?
